import json,subprocess,statistics,os,hashlib,time
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/excel-context-cache-pairs';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
snapshot='/Volumes/data/pcemu/snapshots/excel-dependent-recalc-recovered'
task='build/flag-pair/task-120.json'
r={'scope':'Three alternating matched-source pairs with process CPU accounting testing lazy validated CPU-context reuse inside native batches, retaining per-entry code and fetch guards; ordinary uninstrumented FollowJumps in a restored, loaded Excel dependent-recalculation task. Restore is separate; response includes control/capture/poll overhead.','pairs':[],'loadBefore':os.getloadavg(),'startedUnix':time.time(),'binaries':{m:hashlib.sha256((root/({'baseline':'build/native-batch/pcemu','candidate':'build/context-cache/pcemu'}[m])).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for m in ('baseline','candidate')}}
for n in range(3):
 runs={}
 for m in (('baseline','candidate') if n%2==0 else ('candidate','baseline')):
  d=out/('pair-'+str(n+1)+'-'+m)
  cmd=['python3','tools/bench_snapshot_task.py',snapshot,'--task',task,'--repeat','1','--emulator',{'baseline':'build/native-batch/pcemu','candidate':'build/context-cache/pcemu'}[m],'--restore-timeout','90','--output',str(d)]
  with (out/(d.name+'.log')).open('w') as f:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  runs[m]=json.loads((d/'result.json').read_text());print('Finished',n+1,m,runs[m]['medianTaskResponseMs'],flush=True)
 b=runs['baseline']['samples'][0];c=runs['candidate']['samples'][0]
 r['pairs'].append({'pair':n+1,'runs':runs,'responseRatio':b['taskResponseMs']/c['taskResponseMs'],'executionWallRatio':b['executionWallMs']/c['executionWallMs'],'processCpuRatio':b['processCpuTime']['totalMs']/c['processCpuTime']['totalMs']})
 (out/'partial.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
r['medianPairedProcessCpuRatio']=statistics.median(p['processCpuRatio'] for p in r['pairs'])
r['loadAfter']=os.getloadavg();r['finishedUnix']=time.time()
r['medianPairedResponseRatio']=statistics.median(p['responseRatio'] for p in r['pairs'])
r['medianPairedExecutionWallRatio']=statistics.median(p['executionWallRatio'] for p in r['pairs'])
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS',r['medianPairedResponseRatio'],r['medianPairedExecutionWallRatio'],flush=True)

legacyRam.scope: Public standalone Jit::run RAM PUSH/POP/checksum control, no batching or disk. Eight code/stack/paging cases; 50M guest instructions each, shared-host elapsed timing.

mutations.initialFixtureFailure: libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type pc::Fault

limits: Shared desktop host and only six pairs per application; no stable universal gain claimed.
No candidate-specific full OS boot/restart or fresh Setup gate was run because the design is not retained.
Mutation checks include conservative rebuild-counter coverage as well as full reference CPU/RAM comparison; they are preserved as an experimental fixture, not added as production constraints.
An initial fetch-test fixture enabled paging before creating its page tables, producing an uncaught Fault; fixture ordering was corrected before the 759-check pass.
Metadata grows by one 64-bit context stamp per block; guard ordering and Jit layout also change, so RAM control does not isolate one cause.
